I give up. I did not change `/work/putnam_2017_b4.lean`, so it still contains the `sorry`.

The sum is the value at s = 1 of a Dirichlet series. With c_n = 3 if n ≡ 2 (mod 4) and −1 otherwise, the series is Σ c_n·ln(n)/n, and Σ c_n·n^(−s) = −ζ(s)(1 − 2^(1−s))². Evaluating it means differentiating at s = 1, where the series is only conditionally convergent. That needs a boundary-convergence (Abel/Dirichlet-test) result for L-series, plus a Laurent expansion of ζ at 1. I could not find either in the installed Mathlib. Only compiled `.ilean`/`.olean` files are present, so I could not check the source for the relevant lemmas. Building this from scratch is well beyond what I can finish reliably here.
